CREATE DATABASE udacity;

USE udacity
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat] 
WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT ,
FORMAT_OPTIONS (
FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = FALSE
))
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [DataLakeStorage]
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://adisnycpayrolljohnd.dfs.core.windows.net/payrolldata'
)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [dbo].[NYC_Payroll_Summary_External]( 
[FiscalYear] [int] NULL,
 [AgencyName] [varchar](50) NULL, 
[TotalPaid] [float] NULL 
)
 WITH ( 
LOCATION = 'dirstaging/', 
DATA_SOURCE = [DataLakeStorage], 
FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseDelimitedTextFormat] 
); 
GO
